Might list Hyundai Motor Company (founded 1967) or Hyundai-Kia (joint). Could also list Nissan (founded 1933) if top five includes Nissan instead of Hyundai. content:
**Largest automotive manufacturers — 2010 (by total production volume)**  

| Rank (2010) | Manufacturer (brand) | 2010 Production volume* | Year founded |
|-------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------------|
| 1 | **Toyota Motor Corporation** | **≈ 8.5 million vehicles** | 1937 (Toyota Motor Co. was established on August 28, 1937) |
| 2 | **General Motors Company (GM)** | **≈ 8.2 million vehicles** | 1908 (Founded on September 16, 1908 as “General Motors”) |
| 3 | **Volkswagen Group** | **≈ 7.9 million vehicles** | 1937 (Volkswagen AG was created on May 28, 1937) |
| 4 | **Hyundai‑Kia (Hyundai Motor Company + Kia Motors)** | **≈ 5.0 million vehicles** (combined output of the two companies) | Hyundai Motor Co. – 1967 (founded December 29, 1967)  •  Kia Motors – 1944 (originally founded as Kyungsung Precision Industry on June 9, 1944) |
| 5 | **Ford Motor Company** | **≈ 4.9 million vehicles** | 1903 (Incorporated on June 16, 1903) |

\*Production volumes are the total number of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles produced worldwide during the calendar year 2010. The figures are taken from the International Organization of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers (OICA) 2010 production statistics and are rounded to the nearest 0.1 million for readability.

### Sources
- **OICA – World Motor Vehicle Production 2010** (official annual production tables)  
- Company histories / corporate websites for founding dates:  
  - Toyota Motor Corporation – corporate history page  
  - General Motors – “Our History” page  
  - Volkswagen AG – historical overview  
  - Hyundai Motor Company – “History” section; Kia Motors – “Company History” page  
  - Ford Motor Company – “Our History” page  

These sources are widely regarded as authoritative for both production data and corporate founding information.
